# Dna

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Generation` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public static class Dna
```

An asset's identity: SHA-256 over the recipe id, each layer's variant id, and — for colorized layers — the QUANTIZED color. Quantizing is what makes uniqueness decidable at all; without it two assets a pixel apart in hue would count as different.

```csharp
public static string Compute(string recipeId, IReadOnlyList<LayerSelection> selections);
```

Computes an asset's DNA.

**Parameters**

- `recipeId` (`string`) - The recipe rolled.
- `selections` (`IReadOnlyList<LayerSelection>`) - One entry per layer, in any order — they are sorted ordinally here, which is why the same selection hashes the same on every machine.

**Returns.** Lowercase hex SHA-256.
